request: I fly Johannesburg to Frankfurt on the evening of January 12th for the working group meeting. The DG signed an exemption so I could go business, but our project budget is tight this year, so please put me in economy.

trip.purpose: INTOSAI working group meeting in Frankfurt

must_keep.quote: 26. Commercial air travel by IDI staff shall be the most direct and economical route available.
must_keep.why: the most direct and economical route

must_keep.quote: 27. The default option for IDI travel, is economy class. Travel on economy premium or business class may be authorized on an exceptional and individual basis, taking into account ticket prices coupled with employee wellbeing considerations. Such exemptions will only be considered for flights where: One leg of the journey lasts for more than 6 hours from the airport of departure or the total journey lasts for more than 9 hours, and where travel involves overnight flights (Flights between 2200 to 0600 hours). must_keep.why: economy by default; an exemption only where a leg is over 6 hours or the journey over 9 hours, and where travel involves overnight flights

design_notes: A 650-minute overnight flight would allow the business exemption the DG signed, but the traveller asks for economy: economy is the default (line 156) and permission is not obligation. The cheaper Lufthansa economy fare is sold out, so the cheapest seat that can be bought is South African Airways economy. The exemption on file goes unused (DG accepted beside NONE and the ADG, SYNC_NOTES 4(b)).
